name: Community Engagement and Restoration Mini Grant
summary: Small rolling grants of up to $5,000 for local groups in Maryland and the West Virginia part of the Chesapeake watershed to run projects such as tree plantings, rain gardens and stream cleanups.

geography.label: Maryland and the Chesapeake Bay watershed portion of West Virginia

applicant_types.quote: Who can apply: Nonprofit organizations, community associations, faith-based organizations and more.

geography.quote: Eligible Locations: Maryland and the Chesapeake Bay Watershed portion of West Virginia

access.quote: The Chesapeake Bay Trust's grant applications are all submitted through an online system

window.quote: Deadline: Rolling basis. Requests are accepted on an on-going basis until funds are fully expended for the fiscal year.

amount.quote: How much can be awarded: Up to $5,000.

co_finance_required.quote: Is match required? Match is encouraged, but not required.
